links.outcome: Change in CMS nursing home quality measures after EHR+AI implementation versus EHR-only sites
links.effect: Greater improvements in 16 of 18 quality measures in EHR+AI sites; major falls -9% (95% CI -17, -1); residents needing help with daily activities -22% (95% CI -29, -15).
links.quote: Statistically greater improvements were observed in 16 of 18 quality measures (89%) in EHR+AI sites, with 11 measures (61%) also meeting the parallel trends assumption.

screen.reason: Empirical difference-in-differences study evaluating the real-world clinical and operational impact of deploying an AI/ML clinical decision support tool within EHRs across 218 nursing homes.
